completed_targets.target: Remove AbortSignal/CancelToken listener leak in sendChatCompletion
completed_targets.metric_delta: Before: one leaked 'abort' listener per request pinned to long-lived caller signals; after: axios 1.19 consumes the AbortSignal natively and releases it when the request settles. Zero behavior change for callers (isCancel/aborted error path preserved). Diff: -16/+3 lines in CustomAIClient.js + 3 regression tests (signal passthrough, pre-aborted signal, mid-request abort).
completed_targets.commit: fix(ai): pass AbortSignal directly to axios in sendChatCompletion

completed_targets.target: Cancel in-flight BYOK model calls on suspend (parent + sub-agents)
completed_targets.metric_delta: Before: customSuspendAiRequest only flipped cache status; the in-flight axios call kept consuming BYOK credits until completion. After: each turn registers an AbortController (keyed by request id, sub-agents remember parentAiRequestId); suspend aborts the parent turn and every child turn; the main chat loop swallows user-initiated aborts and returns the suspended cache copy (no error toast, partial answer not written back). Diff +87/-16 client, +85 tests (2 new: suspend aborts in-flight turn, parent suspend aborts sub-agent).
completed_targets.commit: feat(ai): cancel in-flight model turns on suspend

completed_targets.metric_delta: Before: hardcoded 120000ms timeout in sendChatCompletion hard-killed slow local models mid-agent-loop with a generic axios message. After: CustomAIConfig.timeoutMs (optional, positive-number validated, default 120000) flows to axios' timeout option; persists via existing setCustomEndpointConfig/localStorage path with zero UI change. Diff +14/-1 client, +20 tests (config honored, invalid value falls back to default).
completed_targets.commit: feat(ai): configurable per-request timeout for BYOK endpoints

completed_targets.target: Distinguishable 401 error when no API key is configured
completed_targets.metric_delta: Before: a keyless misconfigured hosted provider surfaced a raw 'AI Provider Error (401)' only after a full round trip with no hint. After: sendChatCompletion appends an actionable hint ('No API key is configured... set one in AI preferences') only when status is 401 AND no key is set; keyed 401s pass through untouched. Diff +10/-1 client, +27 tests.
completed_targets.commit: feat(ai): hint missing API key on 401 provider errors

completed_targets.commit: chore(toolchain): pin Node 20 via .nvmrc to match CI

completed_targets.target: Fail loudly on malformed model JSON in customCreateAiGeneratedEvent
completed_targets.metric_delta: Before: a non-JSON model response silently produced a successful EMPTY event insert (isEventsJsonValid: true, creationSucceeded: true) — the user saw 'success' with zero events; a non-array generatedEvents payload went to the sheet unchecked. After: non-JSON responses fail with an actionable message, and generatedEvents (string or array) must parse to a JSON list or generation fails. 3 new tests (invalid JSON, non-list generatedEvents, valid string-array payload). Diff +40/-12 client, 37/37 tests green.
completed_targets.commit: fix(ai): reject malformed model JSON in event generation

completed_targets.target: Verify offline mock test coverage for the local AI client (backlog audit)
completed_targets.metric_delta: CustomAIClient.spec.js (37 tests) runs fully offline: axios is jest-mocked, only URL strings appear, zero network calls — satisfying the 'offline mock test runner' backlog item. testConnection audited: /models fallback benefits from the cycle-4 401 hint via sendChatCompletion; no change needed.

completed_targets.target: Local-model token-budget calculator + history trimmer for scene context
completed_targets.metric_delta: Before: gameProjectJson + unbounded conversation history were embedded verbatim with no size management — big projects silently exceeded local models' context windows (8k-128k) and got truncated or errored. After: dependency-free chars/4 estimator (estimateTokens), model-family budget (getTokenBudget: llama 4k, mistral/qwen 16k, gpt/claude/deepseek 64k input — half the window reserved for output), and trimMessagesToBudget which drops oldest history (never system prompt or newest exchange; tool outputs dropped with their tool_calls assistant so servers never see orphans) in both chat-turn and sub-agent paths. 4 new test blocks; 41/41 green.
completed_targets.commit: feat(ai): token-budget estimation and history trimming for local models

completed_targets.target: Structured tool-call argument validation in parseAssistantMessage
completed_targets.metric_delta: Before: tool-call arguments accepted any parse result (arrays/scalars included) and executed with whatever the model emitted; malformed JSON silently degraded to {}. After: arguments must parse to a non-null, non-array object — anything else is sanitized to {} with a console.warn naming the tool, and the function_call content round-trips the sanitized arguments. 3 new tests (valid object, malformed JSON, array/scalar rejection); 44/44 green.
completed_targets.commit: fix(ai): validate tool-call arguments are JSON objects

completed_targets.target: Per-tool JSON Schema validation of tool-call arguments against GDEVELOP_OPENAI_TOOLS
completed_targets.metric_delta: Before: parsed tool arguments only needed to be JSON objects; wrong property names/types (e.g. sceneName vs scene_name) reached tool implementations unvalidated and failed downstream with confusing errors. After: validateToolCallArguments checks required properties, primitive types, enum values, and unknown arguments against each tool's declared parameters; schema-invalid calls are sanitized to {} with a warning listing every violation. One pre-existing spec fixture updated (used a non-schema property name — pinned the old unvalidated behavior). 5 new tests; 49/49 green.
completed_targets.commit: feat(ai): validate tool arguments against tool JSON schemas

completed_targets.target: Sanitize persisted custom-AI config on load (localStorage trust boundary)
completed_targets.metric_delta: Before: getCustomEndpointConfig spread raw localStorage JSON over defaults — a mistyped/corrupt entry (temperature: 42, customHeaders: [..], timeoutMs: 'fast') flowed straight into request building and header construction. After: every field coerced to its declared type on load (booleans strict, strings type-checked, temperature clamped to [0,1], positive-number guards on timeoutMs/maxTokens, customHeaders filtered to string->string entries); corrupt JSON still falls back to defaults. Full suite baseline also established this cycle: 176 suites / 1944 tests, all passing. 3 new tests; 52/52 module green.
completed_targets.commit: fix(ai): sanitize persisted custom-AI config on load
